title: tests/app_identity main.c includes lichen/coap_keys.h with no include path
description: lichen/tests/app_identity/src/main.c:13 includes <lichen/coap_keys.h>, but the test enables no LICHEN_COAP* Kconfig and its CMakeLists adds no coap include dir (only the coap subsystem's CMakeLists zephyr_include_directories exposes it). Found while verifying project-LICHEN-worker6-6fg3 on the AWS waves-base baseline: native_sim/native/64 build dies at compile with 'lichen/coap_keys.h: No such file or directory', so the image never reaches the link stage. main.c does not call any coap_keys_* function (include is vestigial) — remove the include or add CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS + the include dir. meshcore_gateway_adapter and meshtastic_ble main.c files are unaffected.
